I am an old woman of 76 years, and this small piece of land I farm is not even mine — I rent it. My strength is not what it used to be, so I grow my cassava and cocoyam the way my mother taught me. I cannot afford these chemical fertilizers from the market, but I put the goat droppings and kitchen ash on the soil. My children and grandchildren help me when they can, especially at clearing and harvest time.
